The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's premature completion judgment at step 17. WebSurfer's screenshot showed only the first 15 revisions, all from November 2024 to January 2025. The request needed revisions up to 2022 and then a count of those before April 2018, so the history had to be paginated further. The Orchestrator nonetheless set `is_request_satisfied` to true, which ended the run without any count. The termination step then reported "50," a number no agent had derived from the data.

AGENT: Orchestrator (thought)
STEP: 17
